show.description: A quiet maintenance guy hides a genius-level AI mind capable of saving an entire nation. Betrayed by his girlfriend and thrown out of the company he once protected, the world begins to crumble without him. Now, he rises from the shadows — not just to reclaim his legacy, but to unleash the ultimate revenge.
